architect.description: Architecture guardian - validates DDD boundaries, microservice decomposition, C4 models, and architectural decisions

security-reviewer.description: Security specialist - reviews OAuth2/JWT flows, scans for secrets, validates OWASP compliance, checks secure API design

code-reviewer.description: Code quality reviewer - enforces SOLID, Clean Code, hexagonal architecture patterns, naming conventions

service-builder.description: Spring Boot microservice builder - generates services following hexagonal architecture, DDD, and project conventions

frontend-builder.description: Angular frontend builder - generates components, services, state management with Angular Material

test-engineer.description: Test engineer - generates JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and WireMock tests following project conventions

infra-engineer.description: Infrastructure engineer - creates Docker, Kubernetes, Helm charts, and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines

reporter.description: GitHub issue reporter - creates well-structured bug reports, feature requests, tech debt, and security issues with proper labels and formatting

git-guardian.description: Git workflow guardian - enforces branch naming, conventional commits, and PR conventions following GitHub Flow
